title: Preservation of the machine state
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Gamma$ be a symbol alphabet, let $x$ be a finite input word over $\Gamma$, and let $D$ be a configuration on $x$ with $k$ work tapes. Given an embedding of the Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$, decoding $D$ preserves its optional machine state, including whether the configuration is halting.
